theme: Mutual fund literacy: what is an expense ratio, active vs passive, fund categories
headline: Understanding Expense Ratios in Mutual Funds
body: Expense ratio is the annual cost charged by fund managers to operate and manage your investments. Lower ratios mean more of your money stays invested.
caption: Every rupee matters when investing. Knowing your fund's expense ratio helps you understand true costs. Active funds involve more management; passive funds track indexes with lower costs. Compare carefully before investing. #MutualFundLiteracy #ExpenseRatio #ActiveVsPassive #InvestmentCosts #SmartInvesting
